title: Chapter 369
text:
Well, let's just say that writing is for my entertainment. Just like how everyone reads it for entertainment, there's no need to be so angry. The discussion board is also for everyone to use. You can think whatever you want. You can urge me to update or scold me, as long as it's fun. As for why I don't update, I'm not that bored. I want to write more than you guys. It's just that I've been like this ever since I started updating my first book. The more words there are, the harder it gets. How can I be so arrogant …

I posted another single chapter … To be honest, I don't really like posting single chapters unless it's absolutely necessary. Can't I just write it down? When I stopped updating during the National Day holiday, there were also people who were trying to stir things up in the discussion section. Actually, there was no need for that. This is just a normal novel, and I'm just an author who doesn't have much ambition. I'll say something taboo here. If you think this novel is interesting, you can read it. If you don't think it's good, you can always find something you like in the vast sea of books.
